forgetfulness: Does the person repeat the same questions?
Does the person often misplace things?

Does the person mix up people?
Does the person mix up the time of day?

Is the person more withdrawn or apathetic?
Does the person act out of character?
behavioral_problems: Is the person agitated or aggressive?
Is the person restless at night?

caretaker.head_injury: Has the person had a serious head injury with loss of consciousness or a hospital visit?
caretaker.family_history: Has any parent or sibling of the person had Alzheimer's or dementia?

adl.question: Can they get dressed without help?
Can they use the toilet without help?
Can they take their medicines without help?
Can they handle money without help?
Can they make a simple meal without help?
